summary: Iter 123x — validated all three fixes end-to-end. (1) POST /api/public/uploads works with valid token + player_registration scope (200 + UploadRecord.url=/api/uploads/{id}); rejects invalid token (404), wrong scope (400), missing token (400). Protected /api/uploads still requires Bearer (401 — no security regression). (2) Public form /register/player/FK4KROD9kjFb5EGB attaches a PNG to the Passport Size Photo slot without any 'Not authenticated' alert; network shows POST to /api/public/uploads (200). Label reads 'Passport Size Photo' (rendered uppercase via CSS `.uppercase` label styling — source text is correct). (3) Tournament Ops → Madhavrao Scindia Trophy → Finance Console → Invoices tab: 6 buttons with data-testid=inv-view-file-{id} present, tagName=BUTTON. Clicking triggers authenticated GET /api/uploads/{id} → 200, then window.open with a blob: URL (openAuthedFile helper works). No 401.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/uploads.py: /public/uploads and /uploads share ~80% of the streaming/persistence logic. Consider extracting a common `_write_upload_stream(...)` helper to avoid drift when limits/mime rules change.
The extra `public_registration_token` stored on the doc is good for audit; consider indexing db.uploads.public_registration_token if bulk-lookup by campaign is ever needed.
